common_estimand_target: Tier B_abs: delta_abs_beta_partner_C = |beta_pollinator| - |beta_plant|, days / degree C; negative = plant more responsive

freimuth_2022.uncertainty_status: delta uncertainty can be approximated from disjoint group SEMs, but interaction-level dependence remains for a direct synchrony estimand
freimuth_2022.source_role: large local-system benchmark already frozen in E6

kehrberger_holzschuh_2019.matched_exposure: mean site temperature; published slopes per 0.1 C

tier_B_example.uncertainty_status: partner covariance is not reported; a difference SE reconstructed from marginal CIs under independence is diagnostic only

xie_claytonia_andrena.extension_source: Xie et al. 2025 raw/code; not a second independent system
xie_claytonia_andrena.uncertainty_status: source table labels coefficient spreads as SD and the two partner models have no reported cross-model covariance; do not treat sqrt(0.2^2+0.5^2) as an inferential SE

de_manincor_2023.plant_result: warming advanced community flowering onset and peak; peak 7.4 days earlier
de_manincor_2023.pollinator_result: Osmia lignaria emergence not detectably altered by warming
de_manincor_2023.reason_not_primary: one greenhouse room per temperature treatment; treatment is confounded with room and partner endpoints use different model scales

kharouba_vellend_2015.matched_exposure: same spring temperature predictor for butterfly flight and plant flowering
kharouba_vellend_2015.uncertainty_status: direct published mixed-model contrast; source accounts for repeated butterfly and plant identities

current_ecological_pattern.interpretation: local plant-pollinator systems do not show a universal ordering in which plant or pollinator phenology is always more temperature-responsive; three screened systems are plant-dominant whereas Xie is pollinator-dominant at the global fixed-effect level and reports geographic reversal
current_ecological_pattern.inference_boundary: point-estimate heterogeneity is descriptive; pooled inferential meta-analysis is blocked until partner-difference uncertainties are harmonized

blockers: Freimuth B_abs contrast requires covariance handling between separately summarized group means; its direct interaction asynchrony effect is Tier A rather than B_abs
Kehrberger WMD partner-difference covariance is not directly reported; its direct lag model uses first-event phenology
Xie partner coefficient ± values are labelled SD and cross-model covariance is not reported
study designs and phenophase summaries differ, requiring declared design/phenophase sensitivity before pooling

next_allowed_step: recover covariance-safe B_abs or a common direct Tier-A relative-timing effect for at least two additional independent systems; only then open formal E7 pooling
